tasks.title: internal/sos/detector.go — keyword + device-flag + JSON-field detection (MESHSAT-170 core)
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/001-sos-trigger/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/schemas/sos-event.json, contracts/asyncapi.yaml, acceptance/sos-trigger.feature}. SECOND: implement internal/sos/detector.go with a Detector type that exposes Flag(msg DecodedMo) (*SosEvent, error). Detection covers REQ-002 (SOS literal), REQ-003 (MAYDAY literal), REQ-004 (EMERGENCY literal), REQ-005 (device sos_flagged), REQ-006 (JSON sos:true), REQ-016 (malformed UTF-8 OR JSON parse failure returns (nil,nil) and the caller writes the sos.malformed audit entry). NO MQTT publish in this file (that lives in T-002). Detection-reason enum: keyword|device_flag|payload_field per the schema. Capture keyword_matched when reason=keyword. Use crypto/rand for event_id UUID generation. Tests: internal/sos/detector_test.go covers each REQ-NNN with a table-driven test; one test per REQ-NNN row.

tasks.title: internal/rockblock/sos_hook.go — MQTT subscribe + publish + audit + Prometheus wiring
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/001-sos-trigger/{requirements.md, design.md, contracts/asyncapi.yaml, contracts/schemas/sos-event.json}. SECOND: wire the SOS hook into the existing rockblock handler — REQ-001 (subscribe meshsat/+/mo/decoded on startup), REQ-007 (publish meshsat/{device_id}/sos on Detector.Flag returning non-nil event), REQ-010 (audit entry sos.detected), REQ-011 (payload conforms to sos-event.json — use the same schema-package as other code), REQ-012 (block publishes during detector startup via a sync.WaitGroup), REQ-017 (increment hub_sos_events_total Prometheus counter labelled by device_id). DO NOT import internal/escalation here — that integration is T-003.

tasks.title: internal/escalation/sos_handler.go — escalation fan-out + retry + default-chain fallback + rate-limit bypass
tasks.prompt: FIRST: read spec/001-sos-trigger/{requirements.md, design.md, acceptance/sos-trigger.feature}. SECOND: implement the SOS-to-escalation glue — REQ-008 (invoke Engine.Trigger on every flagged event), REQ-009 (call ratelimit.BypassFor(deviceID) BEFORE the escalation Trigger), REQ-013 (retry-with-exponential-backoff: 1s, 2s, 4s, then write audit + give up), REQ-014 (fall back to the global default chain when per-device chain is nil), REQ-015 (when both per-device and global-default chains are nil, log WARN with type sos.no-chain + write audit entry sos.no-chain). Tests cover the retry timing with a fake clock; cover both fallback branches.

SECOND: implement the REST surface — REQ-018 (GET /api/sos/recent?limit=N), REQ-019 (tenant_id JWT-claim filter on every query — re-use the existing tenant-extraction middleware), REQ-020 (POST /api/sos/rules validates body against sos-detection-rule.json schema before applying, returns 400 with descriptive error on failure).
